descriptions.WebHooker: GitHub webhook → Discord dispatcher. Receives webhook events via Cloudflare Workers, applies filters, and routes formatted messages to Discord channels or threads.
descriptions.Mailer: A small Go daemon that periodically checks one or more mailboxes for new email and pushes a notification to Telegram and/or Discord bots.
descriptions.Shit-Bot: Automatically monitors X/Twitter users' posts and pushes them to groups or channels via Discord/Telegram bots. Supports keyword filtering, media filtering, tweet-to-image rendering, and a multi-admin approval workflow.
descriptions.x-to-img: API service that converts X/Twitter tweets to PNG images. Built with Hono + Satori, deployable to Cloudflare Workers / Deno Deploy / Bun.
descriptions.SleepyXposed: An Xposed module that monitors foreground app switches on Android devices in real time and syncs them to a Sleepy server for personal online status. Features battery and charging tracking, a configurable server, media status reporting (system hooks / notification listener / dumpsys), and a multi-level logging system.
descriptions.homepage: Source code of this very website, built with Nuxt 4 and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
descriptions.docs: Documentation site for Elysola, built with MDX, hosting usage guides and developer docs for our projects.
descriptions.icon: Elysola brand icons, with build scripts that generate SVG and multi-size PNG assets.
descriptions.icon-showcase: Elysola brand icon showcase site for previewing and grabbing icon assets online.
descriptions.Backuper: Backuper is a server backup tool that supports scheduled or manual backups of directories, MySQL, PostgreSQL and other data sources, uploading archives to local storage, remote SSH, or S3-compatible object storage.
descriptions.Mirror: Mirror repositories from GitHub to GitLab / Codeberg / CNB.
